# Strategic Idea Metadata Schema Template

| Field | Required? | Purpose | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| Idea ID | Yes | Stable identifier | KA001 |
| Title | Yes | Stable name | Community Data Stewardship |
| Domain | Yes | Where the idea applies | Governance |
| Strategic function | Yes | What the idea does | Increase legitimacy |
| Evidence level | Yes | Confidence status | Supported |
| Assumptions | Yes | What must be true | Stakeholders will participate |
| Relationships | Recommended | Connected ideas | Requires decision memory |
| Decision history | Recommended | Traceability | Advanced after review |
| Ethics tags | Recommended | Burden, voice, risk | Stakeholder voice |
